subject: Lovejoy settlement annual report
documented_finding: Wilson lists Annual Report of the North Broadway Social Settlement St. Louis 1903 as a Lovejoy primary source and says it contains a purpose statement activities and worker/task list.
evidence_limit: Physical report not yet recovered; exact wording and Lovejoy office require object-level verification.

subject: Lovejoy formal settlement office
documented_finding: The Book of St. Louisans states Lovejoy was president of the North Broadway Social Settlement from 1902 to 1905 and vice-president from 1905.
evidence_limit: Parenthetical Neighborhood House wording may be retrospective or institutionally imprecise.

subject: Third Ward women's programme
documented_finding: Laura A. Long describes a forty-to-fifty-member Third Ward Improvement Club meeting at the St. Louis North Broadway Social Settlement with household sanitation instruction.
evidence_limit: Does not establish Lovejoy personally designed or supervised the programme.

subject: Housing sanitation and municipal reform
documented_finding: Long describes vacant-lot improvement free baths garbage agitation housing statistics and work for better tenement laws at the settlement.
evidence_limit: Institutional operation can be dated to Lovejoy's directory-attested presidency but cannot be attributed individually to him without the annual report or internal minutes.

subject: Bellamy Club at settlement
documented_finding: Newspaper reports place the Central Bellamy Club at 1223-1225 North Broadway Social Settlement with talks on public ownership single tax Bellamy and industrial conditions.
evidence_limit: Precedes Lovejoy's Washington University appointment and proves no Lovejoy participation.

subject: Louisville same-name false join
documented_finding: Jane Addams Digital Edition identifies a North Broadway Social Settlement in Louisville Kentucky renamed Neighborhood House and links the November 1903 Addams address to it.
evidence_limit: Must not be joined to Lovejoy's St. Louis institution.

subject: Boynton Neighborhood House Association presidency
documented_finding: Unity Church history says Boynton was elected president of a newly reorganized Neighborhood House Association in 1903.
evidence_limit: Conflicts with Lovejoy directory chronology; exact institutional identity and office level remain unresolved.

subject: Neighborhood Association merger control
documented_finding: National Register nomination states Neighborhood Association formed in 1911 by merger of Self-Culture Hall and North Broadway Social Settlement.
evidence_limit: Later merger history does not itself identify all earlier aliases but blocks a simple 1903 merger/rename assumption.

subject: St Louis Civic League archival route
documented_finding: St. Louis Public Library SC 18:91 Box 1 Folder 2 contains Social Settlement in St. Louis with an entry for Neighborhood House 1844 O'Fallon St.
evidence_limit: Entry content has not yet been inspected; may or may not resolve Lovejoy-era names and officers.
